title: CISA added three active flaws to the CISA KEV catalog: Drupal Core RCE (CVE-2026-132165), CVE-2026-131914, and CVE-2026-132224. Patch by Nov
content_md:
CISA added three active flaws to the CISA KEV catalog: Drupal Core RCE (CVE-2026-132165), CVE-2026-131914, and CVE-2026-132224. Patch by Nov

via Mastodon https://securityonline.info/cisa-kev-catalog-drupal-idunno-optimizely/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=jetpack_social

CVE-2026-132165.evidence: Event reports CISA added three active flaws to the KEV catalog, naming Drupal Core RCE CVE-2026-132165.

CVE-2026-131914.evidence: Event names CVE-2026-131914 among the three flaws CISA added to the KEV catalog.

CVE-2026-132224.evidence: Event names CVE-2026-132224 among the three flaws CISA added to the KEV catalog.
